implementation.behavior: The TABLECONTENT writer admits a non-null border LTYPE only when the current write attempt has an exact source-to-emitted LTYPE registration. The emitted group 340 uses that registered output identity. A set LTYPE override with a null or unresolved target, and a nonzero target without the override bit, are refused.
implementation.physicalWire: The independent tag walker verifies the custom LTYPE record identity, LTYPE table membership and owner 5; each border group 340 matches that exact emitted handle.
implementation.typedReadback: Fresh ASCII/binary imports contain exactly one BorderDash LTYPE with the emitted handle, and the typed TABLECONTENT border points to it. Corrected same-adapter retry readback compares all border fields and the same LTYPE identity.
implementation.failureRetry: Changing the selected border to unresolved source handle 0xC103 refuses output without replacing a destination sentinel or changing caller state. Restoring the original LTYPE target allows same-adapter export and full readback. Other existing lineweight, spacing and property-mask rollback/retry controls remain active.
